facts.text: Environment creation and reconstruction tools build three-dimensional virtual job sites through manual and rule-based design or reconstruction from photographs, laser scans and machine recordings.
facts.quote: Environment creation and reconstruction tools build the three-dimensional virtual job site, either by designing it by hand and by rules or by rebuilding a real site from photographs, laser scans and machine recordings.

facts.text: Virtual job-site creation requires objects and surfaces with properties visible to cameras, radar and lidar.
facts.quote: someone must make the pile, the ramp, the parked truck and the person, and give every surface the properties a camera, a radar and a lidar would see.

facts.text: The booklet identifies eleven families of environment-creation methods, including hand-built models, procedural generation, drone photogrammetry, lidar survey, reconstruction from machine recordings, neural reconstruction and reuse of mine plans.
facts.quote: eleven families of method, from hand-built models and rule-based (procedural) generation to drone photogrammetry, lidar survey, reconstruction from the machine's own recordings, neural reconstruction and reuse of mine plans.

facts.text: Combining environment-creation methods matters more than choosing any single authoring package; a quarry model can combine a mine plan, a drone mesh of the active pit, manually filled gaps and hundreds of procedurally generated variants.
facts.quote: a quarry model might start from a mine plan, replace the active pit with a drone mesh, fill gaps by hand and then generate hundreds of variants by rules

facts.text: MathWorks RoadRunner with Scene Builder imports map data and point clouds and exports to CARLA, dSPACE and IPG CarMaker, but its base editor remains road-oriented.
facts.quote: MathWorks RoadRunner with Scene Builder, which imports map data and point clouds and exports to CARLA, dSPACE and IPG CarMaker, but whose base editor remains road-oriented

facts.text: The Fraunhofer ITWM VMC Road and Scene Generator builds scenes from fused real measurements.
facts.quote: the Fraunhofer ITWM VMC Road and Scene Generator, which builds scenes from fused real measurements

entities.name: Fraunhofer ITWM VMC Road and Scene Generator

facts.text: OpenUSD and Omniverse tooling provide a domain-neutral way to describe scenes, combining an open standard with one vendor's components.
facts.quote: OpenUSD and Omniverse tooling, a domain-neutral way to describe scenes (an open standard plus one vendor's components)

facts.text: Unreal Engine editors are used inside Falcon, CARLA and the MathWorks stack.
facts.quote: Unreal Engine editors inside Falcon, CARLA and the MathWorks stack

facts.text: The booklet names COLMAP as photogrammetry software and includes quarry examples from drone surveys.
facts.quote: photogrammetry software such as COLMAP, with quarry examples from drone surveys

facts.text: NuRec, SplatAD and LiDAR-EVS reconstruct appearance from logs but struggle when the sensor viewpoint moves.
facts.quote: neural reconstruction such as NuRec, SplatAD and LiDAR-EVS, which rebuild appearance from logs but struggle when the sensor viewpoint moves

facts.text: Boreal3D is an environment-creation tool for forest plots.
CropCraft is an open-source generator for farm fields.
facts.quote: CropCraft, an open-source generator for farm fields

facts.text: AgriGen generates large agricultural scenes in Isaac Sim.
facts.quote: AgriGen, which generates large agricultural scenes in Isaac Sim

facts.text: MAVS generates off-road terrain with controllable roughness and haze.
facts.quote: MAVS, which generates off-road terrain with controllable roughness and haze

facts.text: ASAM OpenMATERIAL 3D version 1.0.0, dated April 2025, standardizes material properties that sensors react to.
facts.quote: ASAM OpenMATERIAL 3D (version 1.0.0, April 2025) standardizes the material properties sensors react to

facts.text: ASAM OpenMATERIAL 3D excludes dirt on the sensor itself.
facts.quote: it excludes dirt on the sensor itself

facts.text: The booklet identifies job-site reconstruction as a bottleneck because a reusable representation of sites is needed before scenario volume matters.
facts.quote: The booklet calls job-site reconstruction a bottleneck: a reusable representation of sites is needed before scenario volume matters

facts.text: Open road formats assume lanes, so stockpiles, berms and ruts often need custom representations for virtual job sites.
facts.quote: the open road formats assume lanes, so stockpiles, berms and ruts often need custom representations

facts.text: Every captured environment needs a capture date and revision history to avoid ambiguity about which site model is being used.
facts.quote: Every captured environment also needs a capture date and revision history, or "the quarry model" becomes ambiguous
